question.prompt: Calculate \(37^\circ42′+25^\circ30′\) and write the result in the form \(a^\circ b′\). Enter a and b in that order, separated by a comma.

solutions.explanation: Add degrees to degrees and minutes to minutes to obtain \(62^\circ72′\). Since \(72′=1^\circ12′\), the result is \(63^\circ12′\).
solutions.title: Adding and regrouping angle units
